name: Steps / Stepper
summary: Horizontal or vertical progress indicator with generated connectors, active, completed, done, and upcoming step states, plus ordered progress semantics.

anatomy.name: connector
anatomy.description: Generated connector line before each step item except the first.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Step number, icon, or completion mark.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Alternate step label used by some implementations.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default step indicator and label size.

states.name: firstItem
states.description: First step hides the generated connector before it.

states.name: completed
states.description: Completed step connector and indicator state.

states.name: done
states.description: Done step alias currently supported by the CSS adapter.

behavior.name: progressSemantics
behavior.description: Expose the current step and provide a clear accessible name for the progress sequence.

behavior.name: orderedSequence
behavior.description: Steps should preserve a logical ordered sequence even when rendered horizontally or vertically.

behavior.name: orientation
behavior.description: Targets with explicit orientation semantics should synchronize them with the horizontal or vertical variant.

behavior.name: completedState
behavior.description: Completed and done states currently both represent prior completed progress in the CSS adapter.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Selects the horizontal or vertical canonical layout without changing the ordered progress semantics.

accessibility: Use ordered markup or equivalent semantics so the step sequence is understandable without layout.
Mark the current step with aria-current="step".
Do not communicate completion only by color; include text, icon, or state metadata.
Keep horizontal and vertical variants semantically equivalent.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render ordered steps with the same class contract.
